aboutTagline2: Private messaging and payments on the Ixian network.
aboutWhyE2eBody: Only the person you write to can read it.
aboutWhyKeysBody: Keys are made and kept on this device.
aboutWhyNetworkBody: Runs on the Ixian network, peer to peer.
addContactEnterHint: Type or paste their Spixi address (for example 42Spox…M3rci98).
addContactEnterLabel: Enter or paste a Spixi address
addContactNote: Enter an Ixian address to send a contact request.
addContactScanHint: Their QR code needs to be visible on another device, so you can scan it with this one.
addContactSheetLead: You can add a new contact by scanning their QR code, or by entering or pasting their Spixi address.
addLead: Add a mini app from a link, a QR code, or a file. Or explore the directory below.
addMethods: Ways to add a mini app
addressInfoBody: This is your address on the Ixian network. Share it, or let someone scan the code, and they can add you as a contact or send you IXI.
addressInfoSafety: Sharing it is safe: it never gives anyone access to your wallet.
alreadyContact: This address is already in your contacts.
appFetchHttp: The app could not be downloaded from that link.
appFetchTimeout: The link did not respond. Check your connection and try again.
appFetchTooLarge: That app package is too large.
appNeedsOne: Select at least one contact or group to invite.
appUrlInvalid: That link or file isn’t a valid mini app.
appsEmptyBody: Games, tools and AI that run directly in your chats.
backupAdvancedNote: The raw wallet file, for cold storage or other Ixian tools. Doesn’t include contacts or your account.
backupHeroBody: Your identity, wallet and contacts: encrypted with your password into a single backup file.
backupNudgeBody: Spixi is fully decentralized. Your data stays on your device only. To keep your contacts safe and restore everything later, create a backup now.
backupNudgeNote: It’s recommended to back up every time you add a new contact.
backupRestoreNote: Restoring needs this file and your password. Spixi can’t recover either for you.
badAddress: That doesn’t look like an Ixian address.
badPassword: That password contains an unsupported character sequence.
banBody: They won’t be able to rejoin this group.
blindGroupSub: Members can’t see each other’s identity. Only you, the creator, can.
blindSub: Members of a blind group can’t be viewed or added to contacts.
blindTitle: Identities are hidden in this group
callBusy: A call is in progress. End that call first.
callUnavailable: You cannot make a call in this chat.
cancelFailed: Couldn’t cancel the request. Try again.
cancelHandshakeBody: This stops establishing the secure connection and removes the chat.
cancelInviteBody: The invite is removed from their chat. Your card stays here as canceled.
cancelInviteFailed: The invite could not be canceled.
cancelRequestBody: The request is removed from this chat for both of you.
capx_Authentication: Can prove who you are to this app using your Spixi identity, without a password.
capx_MultiUser: Runs shared sessions so you can use this app together with friends.
capx_RegisteredNamesManagement: Can read and manage your registered Ixian names.
capx_Storage: Can save data on your device so it remembers things between sessions.
capx_TransactionSigning: Can ask you to approve IXI payments. You always confirm each one yourself.
chatsEmptyBody: Pick a contact and say hi. Messages go straight to their device, end-to-end encrypted.
confirmCopy: Enter your wallet password to continue.
contactsEmptyBody: Add someone by their Spixi address or QR code. Then you can chat and send IXI.
contributorsLead: Spixi is better because these people cared. Special thanks to:
copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the address text instead
copyFailedOpenQr: Couldn’t copy. Open the QR code to copy the full address.
copyLogFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the log text instead.
createConsent: By creating an account, you agree to the
createFailed: Something went wrong creating the account.
createWarnBody2: It protects your account and wallet on this device. Nobody can reset it, not even Spixi.
declineMsgPreset1: Can’t talk now. I’ll call you back.
declineMsgSub: {name} gets it as a normal chat message.
declinedRequestsEmpty: You have not declined any requests.
declinedRequestsNote: A request from these addresses is ignored when it is sent again. They are not told. Unblock to receive their requests again.
deleteAccountBody: Your wallet, contacts, chat history, files and settings are removed from this device. Without your backup file AND your password nobody can recover the account. Spixi asks you to confirm with your PIN, then shows the welcome screen.
deleteAccountSub: Removes everything from this device: wallet, contacts, chats, files and settings.
deleteAllHistoryBody: Every conversation is removed from this device.
deleteDownloadsBody: Received files are removed from this device. Senders keep theirs.
deleteDownloadsSub: Files received in chats go from this device.
deleteHistoryBody: Messages are removed from this device. The contact keeps their copy.
deleteHistorySub: Messages go from this device. Contacts keep theirs.
devFlashCandidate: Wait for the chat to paint
devFlashInput: Make the chat touchable at release
devLead: Anyone can build a mini app: web-friendly tech, no backend to run.
devNote: The Spixi log on this device. Read-only.
discoverEmptyCat: No {cat} apps yet. Check back soon.
discoverSoon: The Spixi Mini App directory is coming soon. You’ll browse and install featured apps right here.
downloadsEmpty: Files you receive in chats appear here.
editNoLonger: This message can no longer be edited. Your text stays in the message field.
encpassNote: This is the password that encrypts your wallet on this device. Spixi can’t recover it for you.
encpassRejected: That password can’t be used. Pick a different one.
encpassTooShort: The new password needs at least {n} characters.
failedBody: Something went wrong installing this app. Please try again.
feeExplain: Network fee, paid to the Ixian network for processing this transaction, not to Spixi.
feeNeedsAmount: The network fee shows once you enter an amount.
feeUnavailable: The network fee could not be estimated. Close this and try again.
fetchMaybeFailed: If nothing happened, that link may be invalid or unreachable.
fileTooBig50: This file is over 50 MB and can’t be sent.
fileTooBigIn100: This file is over 100 MB and can’t be downloaded.
groupCreateFailed: Couldn’t create the group. Try again.
groupLimitNote: A group can have up to 10 members besides you.
groupNeedsTwo: Select at least 2 people to create a group.
hideOnlineHint: When on, Spixi asks others’ apps to hide your online status and last seen, and you don’t see theirs. Older apps and the network can still see when you are online.
hideRequestBody: The chat is hidden from your list. They still see the request; if they accept it, the chat comes back.
hintAddContactBody: Scan a QR code when you meet.
hintAppsBody: Play or work together inside a chat.
hintBackupBody: Only your backup can restore a lost phone.
hintNetworkBody: Spixi runs on the Ixian network of independent nodes.
hintNoPhoneBody2: Your account is a key on your device.
hintQuantumBody: Current Spixi apps use post-quantum encryption.
hintTipBody2: Open a message’s menu and choose Tip.
hintWalletBody2: Send IXI to a contact in a chat.
howTo2Step1Body: Tap the new-chat button on Chats and pick a contact.
howTo2Step2Body: Show your QR from Account, or scan a friend’s in Contacts › Add contact.
howTo2Step3Body: Tap + in a chat to send or request IXI. You confirm every payment on your device.
howTo2Step4Body: Open Apps to find mini apps you can use together in a chat.
howTo2Step5Body: Save one encrypted backup file from Account › Backup. Without it and your password, nothing can be recovered.
howTo2Step6Body: Your messages are end-to-end encrypted. Keep your password to yourself.
howToIntro2: Six things worth knowing. Tap one to see how it works.
howToJoinBody: Adds the Spixi group chat to your chats, where you can ask questions and follow updates.
howToJoinDone: Spixi group chat is in your chats
installLead: This app can do the following. Tap any to learn more:
installedBody: The mini app is ready to use.
insufficient: Not enough IXI to cover this amount plus the network fee.
keepOpen: Keep Spixi open until the transfer completes
languageAiNote: Some text in this language was translated with AI and can contain errors. Tell us if you find one.
languagePending: Your system language is set for Spixi, but this interface is still shown in English. Its translation is on the way.
lastSeenLongAgo: last seen a long time ago
leaveBody: You’ll stop receiving messages. Rejoining needs a new invite.
leaveGroupBody: Leave this group? You stop receiving its messages. Your copy of the chat is removed from this device.
leaveGroupFailed: You could not leave the group.
leaveGroupNote: Everyone in the group is told you left, even if they are offline right now.
leaveGroupsConfirmBody: You leave the ticked groups first. Their chats are removed from this device. Then the contact is removed.
loadMediaSub: Loading tells the sender’s host that you opened the chat
lockCopy: Enter your wallet password to unlock.
lockFailed: Couldn’t turn on the app lock.
maxBody: This fills in everything you have: {m} IXI after the network fee. You would be left with 0 IXI.
mediaCameraDenied: Spixi needs camera access to take a photo. Allow it in your device settings.
mediaClipboardEmpty: There is no picture to paste.
mediaDecode: This picture could not be read.
mediaStorageDenied: Spixi needs storage access to save the camera photo. Allow it in your device settings.
mediaTooBig: This photo is too large to send as a photo. Use Send file instead.
mediaTooMany: You can send up to 10 photos at a time. The extra photos were left out.
membersNotSynced: Members are not listed for this room yet.
micBusy: You can’t record a voice message during a call.
micDenied: Spixi needs microphone access to record. Allow it when asked, or in your device settings, then tap the mic again.
miniAppInfo: Mini apps are lightweight web apps that run securely inside Spixi. Only add apps from sources you trust.
missingTxOlder: Transactions from before Spixi's starting block are not listed here. ixiscope shows your full history.
missingTxStartingSub: This usually takes a few moments.
missingTxUpToDateSub: Spixi has checked the latest blocks.
moreContacts: {n} more. Keep typing to narrow it down
newTooShort: The password needs at least {n} characters.
nicknameEmpty: Enter a nickname. It’s how contacts see you.
noContactMatch: No contact matches “{q}”. You can paste their address instead.
noGroupPending: Can’t be added until they accept
noSharedGroupsRemovable: No shared groups. This contact can be removed.
notifPushProviderOffAndroid: Off: nothing more is sent to OneSignal and this device is unsubscribed there. Spixi checks for new messages itself and notifies you when it finds some, so they can arrive a little later. The record OneSignal already holds is not deleted by this switch.
notifPushProviderOffIos: Off: nothing more is sent to OneSignal and this device is unsubscribed there. New messages appear when you open Spixi. The record OneSignal already holds is not deleted by this switch.
notifPushProviderOn: On: OneSignal wakes this device the moment a message arrives. OneSignal receives a push token for this device and sees its IP address. It never sees your messages or your contacts.
notifSenderSub: Message text is never shown in notifications
otherWalletBody: You’ll leave this screen and go to setup to create or restore another wallet. Your current wallet stays encrypted on this device.
passwordPhraseHint: Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember.
payRequestGone: This request can no longer be paid.
peerAddressBody: This is their address on the Ixian network. Scan the code or copy the address to send IXI.
peerQrLabel: QR code: this contact’s Ixian address
pendingNote: Waiting for them to accept your contact request.
photoAutoDlHint: Photos up to 10 MB, only while “Load pictures and GIFs” is on.
photoPreviewsHint: Photos you sent or downloaded show as a picture in the chat. Off: every photo stays a file card.
privacySub: Read receipts, typing, online status and media
ratingBody: Your feedback helps us make it better.
readReceiptsHint: When off, others don’t see when you read their messages, and you don’t see when they read yours.
receiveCaption: Scan to send IXI to this address
removeBlockedInline: Still a member of the groups above. Tick them to leave first.
removeBlockedToast: Not removed: still a member of {groups}. Leave the group first.
removeContactBody: Removes the contact and your chat. Adding them again needs a new contact request.
removeContactFailed: The contact could not be removed.
removeFailedToast: The contact could not be removed. Please try again.
removeHistoryFailed: The chat history could not be deleted.
removeSheetBody: Remove this contact from your device? Their chat and files go with them. They keep their copy.
requestFailed: Couldn’t send the request. Check the address and try again.
requestIsMessage: A request is a message. Nothing moves until they pay.
requestMaybeFailed: If nothing happened, that address may already be a contact or invalid.
requestSentPartly: Sent to {n}. The rest are still selected. Try again.
requestSentToMany: Request for {a} IXI sent to {n} contacts
restoreConsent: By restoring your account, you agree to the
restoreFailed: That password didn’t open the backup.
restoreHeroCopy: Choose your backup file and enter your wallet password to bring your account back to this device.
restoreNote: Restoring needs this file and your password. Spixi can’t recover either for you.
retryCopy: Your wallet couldn’t be unlocked with the saved password. Enter it to continue.
revokeRequestFailed: The request could not be revoked.
runsSecurely: Runs securely inside Spixi. Nothing leaves your device without your permission.
sameAsOld: The new password matches the current one.
scanDeniedCopy: Spixi can’t use the camera right now. Allow camera access for Spixi in your device settings, then try again.
scanHint: Point your camera at a Spixi QR code
scanPromptCopy: Spixi needs the camera to scan a contact’s QR code. Nothing is captured until you allow it.
secureNoticeTextE2e: Messages are end-to-end encrypted and can be opened only by the person you sent them to. Nobody in between can read them, not even us.
securityNote: A level sets lock, privacy and notification policy together. You can switch anytime.
selfDestructHint: New messages in this chat disappear for everyone after the selected time.
sendFailed: The payment could not be sent. Please try again.
sendNoAnswer: No response from the app. Check your wallet activity before you try again.
settingsEmptyHint: Choose a setting on the left
shareHint: Share this link with anyone. They can add the app in Spixi from it.
sharedDeleteLocalBody: “{name}” is removed from this device. The message stays in the chat.
sharedGroupsBlock: A contact who is in one of your groups cannot be removed. Tick the groups to leave them first, or keep the contact.
sharedGroupsReady: You will leave the ticked groups and their chats are removed from this device. Then the contact is removed.
sharedGroupsUnknown: Could not check your groups. Keep the contact and try again.
sharedJumpTooFar: This message is further back. Scroll up to find it.
slide1Copy2: End-to-end encrypted and opened only by the person you sent to. Simple, private messaging with no account and no phone number.
slide1Title: Built for you. Owned by you.
slide2Copy: Your unique Spixi address is the only identity you need. Sign up in seconds and share nothing personal. The account is yours alone.
slide2Title: No phone number. No email. Just a nickname.
slide3Copy: A private IXI wallet lives inside every chat. Send and receive payments in a tap, as simple and instant as saying hello.
slide3Title: Send money like you send a message.
slide4Copy: Play games, run tools, chat with on-device AI, or automate your world, all without ever leaving the conversation.
slide4Title: Mini Apps, right inside your chats.
tabNotReady: This section isn’t part of the redesign yet.
textSizeCustom: Custom size ({0}%), set by pinching in a chat. Pick a size to replace it.
tierBasicDesc: Convenience first. Lock optional, previews on, receipts on.
tierCustomDesc: Your individual Security & privacy settings apply as-is.
tierModerateDesc: Balanced. Lock required, auto-lock after 5 minutes, sender-only previews.
tierStrictDesc: Privacy first. Immediate auto-lock, no previews, receipts and typing off.
tipFailed: The tip could not be sent. Please try again.
tipInsufficient: Not enough IXI for this tip.
tipNoAnswer: No answer from the app. The tip may not have been sent.
typingIndicatorsHint: When off, others don’t see when you type, and you don’t see when they type.
unlockFailed: That password didn’t unlock the wallet.
updateCardBody: Update it where you got Spixi.
validAddress: Looks like a valid Ixian address
videoLocationNote: Videos are sent as they are, with any location data inside.
viewerFailed: This image could not be opened.
voiceRecError: The voice message could not be recorded.
voiceSendFailed: The voice message could not be sent.
voiceUnavailable: This voice message can’t be played
waitingForAccept: Waiting for {name} to accept your request
walletEmptyBody: Payments you send and receive show up here.
